zh-CN.pageTitle: PNDS · 版本历史设计核对
zh-CN.variantHint.B: 上方看路线，下方看变化
zh-CN.variantHint.C: 日常保存优先，历史按需展开
zh-CN.rationale.A: 沿用窄文件栏、横向版本树和右侧操作区。合并时只替换文件范围、编辑结果和操作；助手与检查仍使用现有页签，测试沿用底栏和右侧预览。没有步骤条、候选虚线版本或逐文件确认。
zh-CN.rationale.B: B 保留版本树与代码差异同时可见的布局。保存入口在版本树工具栏，版本操作放在差异区标题旁。真实父子关系容易看清，代价是版本树占用纵向空间。
zh-CN.rationale.C: C 优先呈现当前改动与保存，历史以紧凑列表按需展开，每次只展开一个版本。适合较少回顾历史的使用方式；代价是查看差异时需要滚动，跨版本比较的上下文较弱。
zh-CN.commonPrinciple: 保存属于当前工作；查看历史只读；备份始终对应当前工作路线。
zh-CN.reviewTasks: 先选“选择合并版本”，点击合并到当前版本。手动结合双方或请助手协助，再从底栏测试；修改后重测，最后完成合并。场景菜单可查看快进、二进制选择、失效和恢复。

en.variantHint.C: Save first, expand history when needed
en.rationale.A: Keep the narrow file rail, horizontal history and action area. Merging changes only the file scope, result editor and actions. Assistance and checks use existing tabs; testing uses the transport and preview. No stepper, temporary history node or per-file confirmation.
en.rationale.B: B keeps the version graph and differences visible together. Save lives in the graph toolbar, while version actions sit beside the selected title. Parent relationships stay visible, at the cost of vertical space.
en.rationale.C: C leads with current changes and Save. History is a compact list with one expanded version at a time. It suits occasional history review, at the cost of scrolling and weaker cross-version context.
en.commonPrinciple: Save belongs to current work. History inspection is read-only. Backup always follows the working route.
en.reviewTasks: Choose a merge source, start merging, then combine the changes manually or ask the assistant. Test from the transport, edit and retest, then complete the merge. The scene menu also shows fast-forward, binary choice, expiry and recovery.
en.saveExplanation: Save project file drafts first, then record the current project as a local version.
en.newRouteOnSave: Create a route from the older version
en.localSaveNote: Saved on this Mac. This route uses manual backup; saving does not upload to GitHub.
en.scopeExplanation: Record eligible project source, configuration and assets. Project editor drafts are saved to disk first.
en.scopeExclusions: Chats, private creation resources, secrets, caches and dependency folders are excluded. The actual save result determines the final contents.
en.versionReadOnly: Read-only inspection; working position is unchanged
en.renameHint: Change the display name while retaining the version and its parent relationships.
en.author: Author
en.deletedNoOpen: Deleted from the current project; cannot open
en.binaryFile: Non-text file. Only size changes are shown.
en.openFileExplanation: The app opens the current file in its editor and preserves its draft. This prototype shows a read-only preview.
en.graphHint: Connected by parent versions · Click to inspect
en.clickToInspect: Select a version to inspect its files
en.switchExplanation: Switch the workspace to “{version}”. Inspecting history does not perform this action.
en.protectChanges: {count} files are unrecorded, including {drafts} editor draft. Save a version first to preserve them.
en.stopRuntimeNotice: This stops the live test before switching. The test stays stopped afterward.
en.endTaskNotice: The current assistant task ends. You can start a new task after switching.
en.newBranchNotice: Existing routes remain. Name a new route when you first save changes from here.
en.existingRouteNotice: Open the latest version of this route and continue saving along it.
en.restoreNotice: Restore project contents to the current version, retaining saved history.
en.stopThenSwitch: End task, stop test, then switch
en.discardNotice: Discard current unrecorded file changes and editor drafts. Existing versions remain.
en.githubScope: Manage backup for the working route “{route}”. Inspecting history does not change this target.
en.autoBackupHint: Only new versions on this route are backed up automatically. Other routes are configured separately.
en.firstBackupRequired: Complete a manual backup of this route before enabling automatic backup.
en.bindingHint: These actions clear the old target’s upload queue. Local versions remain.
en.unbindNotice: Unlink the old target and clear its upload queue, retaining local versions. This prototype only simulates unlinking; select and confirm a replacement in the full workflow.
en.backupScope: Back up {count} pending versions and their existing history on the working route “{route}” to this repository.
en.backupExclusions: Other routes, unrecorded file changes and editor drafts remain local.
en.offlineExplanation: Local versions are saved. Pending backups retain their original route and target. Continue after reconnecting.
en.lastChecked: Remote information was last checked today at 14:20.
en.updateProtection: Handle unrecorded changes and assistant tasks, and stop the live test before applying GitHub versions.
en.updateExplanation: The remote history can continue directly. Advance the working route to the new GitHub version without creating a fork.
en.divergedExplanation: Local and GitHub each have independent new versions. Direct update or backup is unavailable. Both histories remain.
en.externalResolution: Merge or reconcile this route in an external Git tool, then check again here.
en.resumeScope: Complete only the originally confirmed initial upload. Versions saved during the interruption remain local for a later backup.
en.connectScope: Before the first upload, confirm the repository, visibility, working route and included history. History may contain files deleted later.
en.connectDemo: This shows the location of the action. Repository creation, authorization and first-upload forms retain their existing workflows and are outside this study.
